label: PF Backlog 110
title: Dynamic artifact format policy (md canonical + derived pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx per agent+doc-type)
body:
[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] Genuinely new backlog item (dedup-checked).
Policy: .md is the CANONICAL default artifact format for EVERY artifact. ADDITIONAL formats
(.pdf/.docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.svg/.drawio ...) are chosen DYNAMICALLY per project + artifact type AT THE
AGENT level: specs->pdf/docx; data model/ER->png/svg/drawio; test results->xlsx; decks/marketing->pptx
(illustrative, not exhaustive). ALL derived formats are GENERATED (never hand-edited).

RELATED (not equivalent): BI-0087 caps at .md + .pdf only and has no per-agent format-selection
policy; this item generalizes the format policy beyond .pdf. Closest dedup match = BI-0087 (0.52).
The dashboard must SHOW/SELECT the available formats per artifact and download each; reuse the
existing artifact registry/viewer surface (dashboard BI-0035) - no new dashboard item.

dashboard_impact.reason: The dashboard artifact viewer must show and let the user select/download the available derived formats (pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/svg/drawio) per artifact; reuse the existing artifact registry/viewer surface.
